title: Invariant divisorial direct image sections
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $U\subseteq X$ an open subset, $G$ a group acting by scheme automorphisms $a_g$, and $q:X\to Y$ a $G$-invariant morphism. For each etale $W\to Y$, let $W_X=W\times_Y X$ and let $g_W:W_X\to W_X$ have projections $\operatorname{pr}_W$ and $a_g\operatorname{pr}_X$. Define the section monoid of the invariant divisorial direct image to be the submonoid of $\Gamma(W_X,\mathcal O)$ consisting of the divisorial sections of [def-trf-log-regular-pair] relative to $U$, fixed by $g_W^*$ for every $g$. Equivalently it is $M_X(W_X)\cap\bigcap_g\operatorname{Eq}(g_W^*,1)$, with multiplication inherited from functions. When $G$ preserves $U$, restriction of functions gives precisely the sheaf $(q_*M_X)^G$; the definition specifies its actual section monoids and structural inclusions, without choosing an abstract isomorphic monoid.
